reason: Decided on the packet alone: one WebSearch returned only stale 2013-2024 results, so I have no current news to support a change. The book is +5.99% vs SPY +2.94% with 34% cash, and no stop or take-profit fired during the semiconductor selloff, because the book holds energy, value, financials and healthcare rather than chips. XLE (+7.2%) and XLV (+5.7%) are intact momentum legs; XLF (-0.4%) and IWD (+1.8%) are flat and well inside their stops. With no evidence of broken momentum, rebalancing would only cost basis points, so I keep the book and its standing stops and take-profits.
